{{Current events|year=2025|month=02|day=27|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
****As part of the first stage of the [[ceasefire]] deal, [[Hamas]] releases the bodies of four [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]] in return for the [[Israeli government]] releasing 617 [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinian prisoners in Israel|prisoners]]. The second phase of the ceasefire has not been negotiated. [https://www.dw.com/en/final-swap-of-gaza-truce-deal-sees-return-of-4-dead-hostages/a-71767402 (DW)]
**Thirteen people are injured in a [[Vehicle-ramming attack|car-ramming attack]] in [[Pardes Hanna-Karkur]], [[Israel]]. The suspect, a Palestinian residing in [[Ma'ale Iron]], is later shot and killed by [[Israel Police|police]] after an attempted [[stabbing]] attack. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/teen-in-critical-condition-after-terror-suspect-plows-car-into-bus-stop-injuring-13/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[2025 Bukavu offensive]]
***[[2025 Bukavu M23 rally bombings]]
****A [[grenade]] attack at an [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rally in [[Bukavu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], celebrating their recent victory over [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|government forces]] in the city, kills at least eleven people and wounds 65 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blasts-m23-rally-eastern-congo-kill-11-wound-65-rebel-leader-says-2025-02-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]]
***Jailed [[Kurds|Kurdish]] leader and [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] (PKK) founder [[Abdullah Öcalan]] calls for an end to the conflict with [[Turkey]] and asks the group to disarm and disband, amid peace efforts between the [[Turkish government]] and the PKK led by the pro-[[Kurds in Turkey|Kurdish]] [[Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party]]. [https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/turkey/27022025 (Rudaw)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-pro-kurdish-party-sets-off-visit-jailed-militant-leader-2025-02-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-ocalan-calls-for-pkk-to-lay-down-weapons/a-71773113 (DW)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Somalia|Somali]] capital city [[Mogadishu]] enters a security lockdown after several [[mortar (weapon)|mortars]] were fired toward [[Aden Adde International Airport]] during a visit from [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]]. [http://v.aa.com.tr/3494950 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[Somali National Army|Somali forces]] regain control of [[Balad, Somalia|Balad]] after [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] launches a coordinated attack, detonating [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bombs]] and briefly seizing the town. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200443/somali_forces_regain_control_of_bal_ad_after_deadly_al_shabaab_attack.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Villa Somalia]] security guards open fire on civilians at [[Lido Beach, Mogadishu|Lido Beach]] in Mogadishu while attempting to clear the beach ahead of a visit from Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, killing a teenage boy and wounding several others. [https://www.idilnews.com/teenager-shot-dead-as-somali-security-forces-clear-beach-for-ethiopian-pms-visit/ (Idil News)] [https://hbnonlinetv.com/khasaare-dhimasho-oo-ka-dhashay-rasaas-lagu-kala-ergayey-dad-shacab-ah-muqdisho/ (HBN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Denmark–United States relations]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] retailer group [[Salling Group]], which operates around 34% of the [[retail]] [[market share]] in the country, announces it will start differentiating brands owned by [[European Union|European]] companies from [[United States|American]] ones, in retaliation to [[United States President|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[proposed United States acquisition of Greenland|proposed acquisition]] of [[Greenland]], an [[autonomous territory]] of the [[Danish Realm]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/danish-grocery-chain-to-distinguish-european-from-us-goods/a-71773488 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A fire at a three-story residential building in [[Quezon City]], [[Philippines]], kills eight people and injures one other. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-deadly-building-fire-ee49c46908c2d074b5a229faf773b170 (AP)]
*Two people are killed when a [[Robinson R44]] helicopter crashes on a private property in [[Uvalde, Texas|Uvalde]], [[Texas]], United States. The [[Federal Aviation Administration]] and the [[National Transportation Safety Board]] are currently investigating the accident. [https://www.kens5.com/video/news/local/texas/latest-details-in-deadly-helicopter-crash-in-kinney-county/273-77d7fde6-3362-4432-a665-e7642e95ffbd (KENS-TV)]
*Two [[Russians|Russian]] tourists are killed in a [[shark attack]] while [[scuba diving]] in the [[Verde Island Passage]] off [[Batangas]], Philippines. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/philippines-shark-attack-2-tourists-killed-popular-diving-spot (Fox News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United Kingdom–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] meets with [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], for talks that include the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]] [[peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|peace negotiations]]. Starmer also presents a letter from [[Monarchy of the United Kingdom|King]] [[Charles III]] inviting Trump to visit [[London]] later this year. [https://www.npr.org/2025/02/27/nx-s1-5310656/trump-keir-starmer-russia-ukraine (NPR)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Persecution of Uyghurs in China]]
**Forty [[Uyghurs|Uyghur]] men detained in [[Thailand]] for over a decade are deported to [[China]], despite concerns regarding their likely imprisonment. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/27/40-uyghur-men-detained-in-thailand-for-more-than-a-decade-have-been-deported-to-china (Al Arabiya)]
*The [[Tribunal de grande instance de Paris|prosecutor's office]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], closes a [[complaint|criminal complaint]] case by the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (DRC) against technology company [[Apple (company)|Apple]] for alleged [[money laundering]] and [[unfair business practices|deceptive business practices]] related to the purchase of [[illegal mining|minerals]] in the DRC from [[List of armed groups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo|armed militias]]. It is one of the DRC's two lawsuits, with another in [[Belgium]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/paris-prosecutor-closes-case-against-apple-over-congo-minerals-document-2025-02-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Austrian legislative election]]
**The [[Social Democratic Party of Austria|Social Democratic Party]], the [[Austrian People's Party]], and the [[NEOS (Austria)|NEOS]] party in [[Austria]] agree to form a [[coalition government]], leaving out the [[far-right politics|far-right]] [[Freedom Party of Austria|Freedom Party]], who won the most seats in the [[National Council (Austria)|National Council]] in the 2024 legislative election. The coalition agreement ends Austria's longest period without a [[Government of Austria|government]] since [[World War II]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/austria-centrist-parties-form-coalition-without-far-right/a-71765298 (DW)] [https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/austria-centrist-parties-agree-on-coalition-government/ (Euractiv)]
*The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] bans [[NASA]] scientists and US government officials from attending the UN [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change]] conference that started this week in [[Hangzhou]], [[China]], which are focused on the seventh [[IPCC Sixth Assessment Report|IPCC Assessment Report]] on [[climate change]]. [https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-00596-0 (''Nature'')]
'''Science and technology'''
*[[Meta Platforms]] says it has fixed an error that resulted in [[Instagram]] users' [[Instagram Reels|Reels]] feeds displaying violent and graphic videos despite these users having [[content filter]]s enabled. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/27/meta-fixes-error-that-flooded-instagram-reels-with-violent-videos (Al Arabiya)]
*[[OpenAI]] releases their latest large language model, [[GPT-4.5]]. [https://www.theverge.com/news/620021/openai-gpt-4-5-orion-ai-model-release (''The Verge'')]
